title: EmailPush: support AND/OR/NOT and the required FilterConditions
description: b3e96a0 (#479): MUST support AND/OR/NOT; with urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail every Email/query FilterCondition, else at least hasKeyword, notKeyword, from, to, cc, bcc, subject, header, minSize, maxSize. Reuse the Email/query evaluator; test each condition.
